program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const t = time; const tossedHeight = Math.max(0, launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t); const tossedVelocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const tossedAcceleration = -gravity; const gateOpen = t >= apexTime; const dropHeight = gateOpen ? Math.max(0, apexHeight - 0.5 * gravity * Math.pow(t - apexTime, 2)) : apexHeight; const dropVelocity = gateOpen ? -gravity * (t - apexTime) : 0; const dropAcceleration = gateOpen ? -gravity : 0; let tossState = "Rising"; if (t < 0.05) tossState = "At launch"; else if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) < 0.05) tossState = "At the top"; else if (t > apexTime) tossState = tossedHeight <= 0.01 ? "At launch height" : "Falling"; let dropState = "Held in place"; if (gateOpen) { if (dropHeight <= 0.01) dropState = "At launch height"; else dropState = "Falling together"; } else if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) < 0.05) dropState = "Just released"; const heightScale = 150 / 2.2; const originY = 360; const tossX = 200; const dropX = 440; const tossY = originY - tossedHeight * heightScale; const dropY = originY - dropHeight * heightScale; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 80, y: 60, w: 240, h: 330, title: "Toss lane", state: tossState, id: "lane.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 340, y: 60, w: 240, h: 330, title: "Drop lane", state: dropState, id: "lane.drop" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.toss", { x: tossX - 60, y: originY, length: 220, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.drop", { x: dropX - 60, y: originY, length: 220, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", tossX, tossY, 28)); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.drop", dropX, dropY, 28)); const gateY = originY - apexHeight * heightScale; objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate", dropX, gateY, { open: gateOpen, w: 44, label: "Apex gate" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", { x: tossX - 22, y: tossY }, { value: tossedVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, minLength: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", { x: tossX + 22, y: tossY }, { value: tossedAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 6, minLength: 12, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", { x: dropX - 22, y: dropY }, { value: dropVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, minLength: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", { x: dropX + 22, y: dropY }, { value: dropAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 6, minLength: 12, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(tossX + 45, tossY - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(tossedVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(tossedAcceleration, 2) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(dropX + 45, dropY - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(dropVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(dropAcceleration, 2) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.drop" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossedVelocity }, { id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossedAcceleration }, { id: "dropVelocity", value: dropVelocity }, { id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropAcceleration }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, apexTime, apexHeight, tossedVelocity, tossedAcceleration, tossedHeight, dropVelocity, dropAcceleration, dropHeight } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a tossed ball reaching its apex with a second ball released from rest at that exact moment.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball. At the top, the toss velocity is zero while its acceleration remains downward at g. A release gate then drops the second ball from rest.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
